scripts.assets: npm run models && npm run world:validate
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src build tools tests docs README.md ARCHITECTURE.md prompt.md index.html vite.config.js tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json package.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src build tools tests docs README.md ARCHITECTURE.md prompt.md index.html vite.config.js tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json package.json
scripts.lint: oxlint src build tools tests --deny-warnings && oxlint --type-aware src --ignore-pattern '**/*.js' --ignore-pattern '**/*.mjs' --deny-warnings
scripts.prebuild: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
